sections.title: Acceptance of terms
content: By accessing or using VerifyMzansi ("the Platform"), you agree to these Terms.

We may update these Terms. For a material change we give at least 14 days' notice by email or on the Platform before it takes effect. If you keep using the Platform after that date, the updated Terms apply; if you do not agree, you may stop using it and close your account.

sections.title: Account registration
content: To post on VerifyMzansi, you must:
• Be at least 18 years old
• Provide accurate and truthful information
• Complete identity verification
• Maintain the security of your account credentials
You are responsible for all activity under your account.

sections.title: Account posting obligations
content: As an account holder, you agree to:
• Post only items, businesses, offers, or events you legally own or are authorised to advertise
• Provide accurate descriptions, images, pricing, and business details
• Not list prohibited items (weapons, illegal substances, counterfeit goods)
• Not show an identifiable child in a post without the consent of the child's parent or guardian
• Show your licence or registration number in the post when the law requires one for what you offer
• Comply with the Consumer Protection Act (CPA) of South Africa and all applicable SA laws

Before submitting a post, you must explicitly accept these Terms. We record your acceptance and the time you gave it. If we change these Terms, you must review and accept them again before submitting further posts.
Each post may include one video. A video may be at most 2 minutes long, and a video for an event at most 1 minute.

sections.title: Prohibited content
content: Strictly prohibited on VerifyMzansi:
• Fraudulent, misleading, or deceptive listings
• Hate speech, harassment, or discriminatory content
• Illegal goods, spam, phishing, or malware
• Impersonation or IP infringement
• Sexual or violent content, and adult or sexual services
• Job ads that ask applicants to pay to apply or to get the job

Some goods and services may be posted only by someone the law allows to offer them, with any licence or permit the law requires: liquor, tobacco and vaping products, medicines, loans and other financial products, and live animals and wildlife products.
We may remove a post, or hide it while we check, when we receive a credible complaint that it is unlawful or breaks these Terms.

Violation may result in the content being removed and the account being suspended at once, or a permanent ban. Paid slots end only as set out under Refunds & cancelling below (for an individual, after written notice and 20 business days to remedy a material breach), and any refund is handled there and under your statutory rights.

sections.title: Our role
content: VerifyMzansi is a South African platform that connects people with businesses, products, services, tourism and events. We publish posts and pass on enquiries; we are not a party to any deal between users.

We do not sell, deliver, hold, inspect or insure the goods, services, stays or events posted, and we do not handle payments between users. Any agreement, payment or delivery is between the buyer and the poster.
We cannot recover money or goods lost in a deal between users, but we will act on reports, remove content and restrict accounts where our rules are broken, and we cooperate with law enforcement.

sections.title: What our checks mean
content: Stickers and badges show which checks were completed and when. They are signals, not guarantees.

• ID reviewed — before anyone can post, our team reviews their phone number (by one-time code), their SA ID or SA passport and a selfie. This is a staff review of the documents submitted; it is not a Home Affairs, criminal or credit check. Location is the province and city the poster gives us.

• CIPC registered (optional, for registered companies) — our team checked CIPC's records that the company is registered and In Business, and that the person who runs the profile is a director or member, or a confirmed company representative. It is not a tax, B-BBEE, credit or quality check.

• Seen by VerifyMzansi (optional, any business) — our team saw the business operating, in person or on a live video call, and the sticker shows where and when. It is not a quality rating or an endorsement.

The CIPC registered and Seen stickers last 12 months and are removed if they expire, if ownership changes or if we revoke them. A business without these stickers has simply not asked for, or not yet passed, those checks.
Verification does not guarantee that a user, business profile, product, rental, job, event, price, payment or transaction is safe, lawful, available or free from risk.
Users must still follow safe trading practices, inspect goods, verify ownership, keep records and report suspicious behaviour.

sections.title: Slots & prices
content: A paid plan buys posting slots, as Individual slots or as a Multi-listing package. A slot holds one live post at a time for a fixed number of days. The price is the slot price for each slot and each 30-day period: slot price × number of slots × number of 30-day periods. There are no discounts for more slots or longer periods. For example, 2 Individual slots for 90 days cost 2 × 3 × R69 = R414, and a package of 25 slots for 90 days costs 25 × 3 × R100 = R7,500.

Individual slots cost R69 per slot for each 30 days: R69 for 30 days, R207 for 90 days or R414 for 180 days. An Individual slot can hold a post in any of the three posting areas. You may hold 1 to 4 Individual slots at a time. The limit counts every Individual slot held by the same ID-reviewed person, and each slot has its own end date. Your free first post, a slot we grant you and a sponsored place do not count towards the 4. We may agree in writing to let a business whose details we have checked hold more Individual slots for a limited time; that written offer states how many and how much notice we give before it ends.

Slots and Multi-listing packages are on sale only when the pricing page offers them. While they are not on sale, the pricing page says so and nothing can be bought; the free first post and free events stay available, and slots and packages already bought keep running.

Fair use: each paid slot can take at most 4 posts going live in each 30-day period. A new post and an ended post brought back each count; editing a live post does not. Events are free until the event ends, subject to fair-use limits. In a Multi-listing package, all its slots share this count (see Multi-listing packages).

Paid time starts when your payment is confirmed, not when your post is approved: a slot's days are counted from that moment (never calendar months) and keep running while a post in it waits for review. Paid visibility starts only after the payment is confirmed. All slots are prepaid; nothing renews automatically and we never charge you automatically.
Renewing early: if you renew an Individual slot before it ends, the new days start when its current days end, so you lose no days.
The slot can be reused once the post in it is deleted, and a new post in the slot runs only for the slot's remaining days.

When a slot ends, or a refund or chargeback withdraws it, the post it paid for is hidden and we notify you by email. You may buy a slot and reactivate such a post within 3 days; after that the post and its media are deleted. If a slot payment is still being confirmed when the 3 days end, deletion waits up to 24 hours more; once a payment is confirmed, the post is kept for 3 days after that payment.
If a slot or package runs for 180 days or more, we email you about 60 business days before it ends to say when it ends and what you can do then. Nothing renews automatically.
Price changes apply only to new purchases. Slots and packages you have already paid for keep their price and their days.
Organisation and sponsor programmes are governed by their written agreement and do not renew automatically.

sections.title: Multi-listing packages
content: A Multi-listing package is one purchase of 5 to 250 slots for one term of 30, 90 or 180 days. Each slot costs R100 for each 30 days: R100 for 30 days, R300 for 90 days or R600 for 180 days. You choose how many slots. Each slot can hold a post in any of the three posting areas, with up to 10 photos and 1 video per post.

Package slots cost R100 each for 30 days, and Individual slots R69. A package gives you more than 4 posts live at the same time, with one end date for all of them. For 1 to 4 slots, buy Individual slots instead.

You can buy a package only after your ID review has been accepted. An account can hold one package at a time; you can buy a new one once it has ended. A package does not mean we have checked your business: the CIPC registered and Seen stickers are separate checks.
All the slots of a package start when your payment is confirmed and end together, at the same moment.

Fair use: a package can take at most 4 posts going live for each of its slots in any 30 days, counted across the whole package. For example, 25 slots allow 100 posts going live in 30 days. A new post and an ended post brought back each count; editing a live post does not, and neither does a post we move into the package from one of your Individual slots.

New posts use your package's free slots first. While your package has more than 7 days left, you cannot buy or renew Individual slots. Individual slots you already hold run to their own end. When one ends, its post moves into a free slot of your package and stays live until the package ends; if no slot is free, the post is handled as set out under Slots & prices.

In the last 7 days of your package you can buy Individual slots again, for example to continue with fewer than 5 posts, and new posts use them first. In those days we move posts from the package into your free Individual slots that run beyond the package's end, so they stay live when it ends.

Adding slots: you can add slots to your package while it runs, up to 250 slots in all. Added slots start when their payment is confirmed and end with the package. You pay only for the whole days left: each added slot costs R100 × days left ÷ 30, rounded to the cent. You can add slots online while at least 7 whole days are left, and by invoice while at least 10 whole days are left.

An invoice for added slots is due 3 days after we issue it, or on the package's last day if that is sooner. If the package ends before the invoice is paid, we cancel the invoice. If money for added slots reaches us after the package has ended, we refund it in full.
A package does not renew automatically and we never charge you automatically. To keep posting after it ends, buy a new package or Individual slots.

When a package ends, or a refund or chargeback withdraws it, the posts it paid for are hidden and handled as set out under Slots & prices: you may buy a slot and reactivate them within 3 days; after that they are deleted with their media.
A package cannot be transferred to another person or account. It ends when its account is closed: closing your account counts as a request to cancel it (see Refunds & cancelling).

sections.title: Paid add-ons
content: While you have a paid slot or package, you can buy these add-ons for a live post. They are not available with only the free first post.
• Urgent: R10 for 7 days. An Urgent label on the post wherever it appears. It is not a safety endorsement.
• Boost: R15 for 7 days. Events only: the event is listed first on the events page.
• Featured: R25 for 7 days. Events only: the event is listed next on the events page, with a Featured label.

An add-on's 7 days start when its payment is confirmed. If the post already has that add-on, the new days start when the current ones end. An add-on does not extend the post's slot and does not renew automatically.

sections.title: Paying, VAT & invoices
content: You can pay online in South African rand through our payment provider's secure hosted checkout. The checkout or bank record should identify VerifyMzansi or its payment provider.

If you need an invoice before you pay, ask for one at checkout. We issue the invoice first. You pay it online with Pay now, through the same secure checkout, or by EFT into the bank account shown on the invoice. The slots start when the payment is confirmed; for an EFT, when the money has cleared in our bank account.

Our payment provider sets a maximum for each online payment, and the checkout shows it. An order or invoice above that maximum cannot be paid online: we issue an invoice and you pay it by EFT. A Multi-listing package of more than 100 slots, and added slots that take a package above 100 slots, are paid by invoice too. An invoice costs the same as paying online. A renewal is not invoiced: if renewing your slots together would be above that maximum, renew them in more than one payment.
The price shown at checkout or on the invoice is the price you pay. We do not add payment fees.

Before you pay, you must confirm that your slot starts as soon as your payment is confirmed and agree that the 7-day cooling-off period therefore does not apply, because the service starts immediately. At the online checkout, and before you pay an invoice with Pay now, you tick a box; if you pay an invoice by EFT, you confirm it when you ask for the invoice, and we record your confirmation before the invoice is paid. We do not take payment without it. Where section 44 of the Electronic Communications and Transactions Act applies, it gives a 7-day cooling-off right; under section 42(2) that right does not apply to a service that started, with your consent, before the 7 days ended. Nothing in these Terms limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act.

VerifyMzansi is not registered for VAT. Our prices include no VAT, and the invoices and payment records we issue show none. If we register for VAT, VAT will be added to our prices from the date of registration and included in the prices shown on the pricing page and at checkout; this applies only to purchases from that date.
After a payment is confirmed (for an EFT, once the money has cleared), we issue an invoice or payment record for it in the billing flow or by email.
We never charge interest or a late fee on an invoice.

sections.title: Refunds & cancelling
content: We refund only where these Terms or the law require it. Apart from your first purchase (below), a change of mind is not a reason for a refund: before paying you agree that your slot starts as soon as your payment is confirmed (see Paying, VAT & invoices).

Your first purchase: if you ask us in writing within 5 business days after its payment is confirmed, we cancel your first purchase and refund it in full. Write to billing@verifymzansi.com from the email address of your account.
A rejected post is not a reason for a refund. The slot stays yours: correct the post and submit it again, or use the slot for another post.

If we fail to provide what you paid for (for example, we wrongly reject a post, a paid slot does not work, or the Platform is unavailable for more than 24 hours in a row), we first put it right by adding the days you lost. If you still ask for your money back after we have offered that, we refund a reasonable part of the price for the days actually lost. For a package, we add the lost days to all its slots, so they still end together.

If you are an individual (including a sole trader), you may cancel a slot or a package by writing to billing@verifymzansi.com from the email address of your account. It continues for 20 business days after we receive your request (the notice period). We then credit the unused whole days at the daily price (the price divided by its number of days), minus a cancellation fee of R50; if the result is R0 or less, nothing is paid. A package is cancelled as a whole, with any slots added to it, and one fee of R50 applies to the package. Because 20 business days is about 28 calendar days, cancelling a 30-day slot or package usually returns nothing. Closing your account counts as a request to cancel all your slots and your package.
Buyers that are not individuals, such as companies, close corporations, trusts, partnerships and associations, are not refunded for unused days.
Billing errors and duplicate payments are refunded in full once we have checked them.

Removing content or suspending an account under Prohibited content does not end your paid slots. We end a paid slot for a material breach of these Terms only after giving you written notice. If you are an individual, the slot ends only if you have not remedied the breach within 20 business days after that notice (Consumer Protection Act, section 14(2)(b)(ii)); you then receive the credit described above, less any proven loss the breach caused us. For a buyer that is not an individual, the slot ends when we give the notice. Where we suspect fraud or chargeback abuse, nothing is credited until the matter is resolved. If a suspension is later overturned, we add the days lost to your paid slots and package.

Refunds are paid to the original payment method, through our payment provider's refund service, or by EFT into a bank account in your own name, within 30 days after we approve them. We consider one refund request per purchase; a package and each addition of slots to it are separate purchases.

A refund or chargeback withdraws the paid days it funded, and the posts they paid for are handled as set out under Slots & prices. Nothing in this section limits your rights under the Consumer Protection Act.

sections.title: Free first post & visibility
content: Once your ID has been reviewed, your first post is free for 7 days, in any of the three posting areas (events are always free). The 7 days start when we approve that post, not when you submit it, so review time does not shorten them. The free post is available once per ID-reviewed person: once its 7 days have started it is used for good, and deleting the post or your account does not reset it. Previous free-post usage counts.

If, when that post is approved, you already have an unused paid slot with at least 7 days left that allows the post's photos and video, the post uses that slot instead and your free post stays unused. A sponsored place, or a free post we grant you, counts as your free post. A rejected post does not use the free post; you may correct it and submit it again. Only one post at a time can wait for the free post.

A free post has standard placement only, with no boost, featured placement, urgent badge, automatic charge or free renewal. After its 7 days, VerifyMzansi may automatically mark the post as expired and remove it from public browsing, search, detail pages, and promotional surfaces.

An expired post, including a free post, is deleted with its media 3 days after it expires unless you reactivate it with a slot, as set out under Slots & prices. A post you mark as sold leaves public view and is deleted with its media 3 days later; it keeps its posting slot until then, you may delete it sooner to free the slot, and you may undo the sale within the 3 days to show it again for the slot's remaining days. A deactivated (paused) post keeps its posting slot, and the days of the slot that pays for it keep running. An event is deleted when it ends. When a post is deleted, the enquiries and other records linked to it are deleted with it, and it cannot be reactivated. A post may be kept longer while a report about it is reviewed or a legal hold applies.

sections.title: Partners & referral links
content: VerifyMzansi works with partners: people and businesses we have approved who recommend the Platform. A partner may earn a commission from us on what a customer they referred pays us. The commission is paid by us and never changes your price.

A partner's link or code counts only if it is recorded within 7 days after you sign up. We record how you came to us once, and that record cannot be changed afterwards, so you can be linked to one partner at most. You may ask us at any time which partner, if any, referred you.

A partner sees how many people they referred and how many of them have paid, and for each payment its amount and the commission it earned. A partner never sees your name, contact details, ID details, bank or card details, or the private details of your posts.

A partner may not take money from you, open an account or do the ID check for you, or promise that a post will be approved. All payments go through VerifyMzansi. Please report a partner who breaks these rules.

sections.title: Promotion & distribution rights
content: When you create a promotion, advertisement, event, or campaign on VerifyMzansi, you confirm that you own it or are authorised to market it.

You keep ownership of what you post. By posting, you give VerifyMzansi a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, copy, resize, show and share your posts (text, photos and videos) to run and promote the Platform. The licence ends when the post is deleted, except for copies in backups and copies we keep while a report is reviewed or a legal hold applies.
You confirm that you own what you post, or have the right to give us this licence, and that it does not infringe anyone else's rights.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
content: We do not guarantee the quality, safety or legality of posted items, services or promotions, or the conduct of users. To the extent the law allows, VerifyMzansi is not liable for loss arising from deals between users or from relying on a post.
This limitation does not apply to loss caused by our gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and does not exclude any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act that cannot lawfully be excluded.
